day_shape: 62 items: Iran's oil minister Paknegad resigns with Boured named acting, Strait of Hormuz tanker struck per UKMTO and Tehran ties reopening to seven US conditions, US reinforcements reported heading to region, Houthis claim Taiz and Aramco hits.

threads.label: Iran oil ministry leadership change
threads.summary: IRIB reported President accepted Oil Minister Mohsen Paknegad's resignation and appointed Hamid Boured as acting oil minister under Article 135. The Deputy Communications Director said the resignation had been previously submitted for personal reasons.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US-Iran seven-day plan
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said the Strait would not reopen until seven conditions from a June interim agreement with the US are met. Foreign Ministry's Gharibabadi and Iran International said Washington's response to Iran's seven-day plan, transmitted via intermediaries, is under review.

threads.label: US military build-up and Iran posture
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported US military reinforcements heading to the Middle East with Israel preparing for possible renewed hostilities with Iran. Iran's army spokesperson told Fars Iran would increase missile range, and IRGC spokesman Mohebyi questioned the cost of the US deployment; Defa Press cited Boroujerdi saying Washington will avoid military action until after elections.

threads.label: Yemen offensive and Houthi strike claims
threads.summary: The Saudi-backed Yemeni presidential council head Rashad al-Alimi announced operations to retake Houthi-held territory, while Jerusalem Post reported Houthis claiming strikes on Saudi Aramco sites at Riyadh and Khurais. Defa Press and IRIB amplified Ansar Allah claims that Taiz had been liberated and the Saudi advance in eastern Jawf repelled, with Mecca defence pact members to discuss Iran's Houthi engagement proposal in Riyadh Monday.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing in Khan Younis of Hamas military-wing commander Muad Gamal Abu Nuseira, surveillance commander Mahmoud Ibrahim Dib Alyan, and Nukhba operative Saqr Nabil Musa Qaisi, identified as director of Turkish aid group Deniz Feneri. Jerusalem Post and Defa Press reported Israeli air strikes on the southern Lebanese town of Hadatha, with Syria condemning IDF operations from Mount Hermon.

threads.label: October 7 anniversary reckoning
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir convened senior officers on lessons from the October 7 onslaught three years on, presenting a certificate to a Unit 8200 warrant officer who had warned of Hamas's plan. Former hostage point man Maj. Gen. (res.) Nitzan Alon said all remaining Gaza hostages could have been released a year earlier but for "political and personal considerations".

threads.label: Iran economic pressure and Khamenei messaging
threads.summary: Iran International reported the rial hit another record low against the dollar under US sanctions pressure, while Tehran mayor Zakani said a price-fix plan for 12 basic commodities would be rolled out nationwide. Khamenei's office posted a "phoenix" message that the Islamic system emerged stronger from the imposed war, alongside imagery from the funeral of the Foreign Minister's sister.

events.summary_en: Zakani: Plan to fix prices of 12 commodity items across the country will be implemented. The plan to fix prices of 12 basic commodities for six months in Tehran has received government attention and is to be implemented nationwide. A committee of 6-7 members is to be formed to review the experiences and infrastructure created and transfer them to the whole country, so that this model can also be implemented in other cities with government and municipality cooperation. Our dear leader stated on 4 June this year that the enemy pursues two objectives; one is to break the resilience of the people and the other is to create computational disruption.

events.title_en: Life Frame | Narratives from the life of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Assistant to the martyred Imam. Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Khamenei has served the leader for many years, at times as executor of his orders and at times as a liaison between the leadership and political, military, cultural, economic officials and institutions. In the political arena and in relations with military officials and political figures, the martyr leader benefited from the services and capabilities of his son Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Khamenei; it is obvious that this did not mean independent and separate interference by him in state affairs, but rather he had a role as an assistant in these matters and was in service to his revered father.

events.summary_en: Taiz siege completed. Yemen's armed forces and popular committees, in continuation of the operation to liberate Taiz province, cut the Taiz-Aden road at Al-Turbah axis at several points and liberated numerous areas from the occupation of Saudi coalition forces. One of these areas is the strategic city of Al-Turbah. Therefore, with the cutting of the only supply line for Saudi-affiliated mercenaries by the Yemeni army, the siege of the central areas of Taiz province and the centre of this province (the city of Taiz) is now complete.

events.summary: 💢 یحیی سریع: پیشروی نیروهای وابسته به عربستان در شرق جوف را دفع کردیم 🔸 سخنگوی نیروهای مسلح یمن اعلام کرد که تلاش نیروهای وابسته به عربستان برای پیشروی به سمت مواضع این نیروها در شرق استان جوف ناکام مانده و در جریان عملیات مقابله با این تحرکات، شماری از تجهیزات نظامی دشمن منهدم و ده‌ها نفر کشته یا زخمی شده‌اند. 🔸 نیروهای باقی‌مانده نیز در صحرای جوف تحت تعقیب قرار گرفته‌اند و تجمعات نیروهای وابسته به عربستان با استفاده از تعدادی موشک بالستیک و پهپاد هدف قرار گرفته است. dnws.ir/003diH @Defapress_ir
events.title_en: Yahya Saree: We repelled the advance of Saudi-affiliated forces in eastern Jawf. Spokesman of Yemen's armed forces announced that the attempt of Saudi-affiliated forces to advance towards the positions of these forces in eastern Jawf province failed, and in the course of operations against these movements, a number of enemy military equipment was destroyed and dozens were killed or wounded.
events.summary_en: Yahya Saree: We repelled the advance of Saudi-affiliated forces in eastern Jawf. Spokesman of Yemen's armed forces announced that the attempt of Saudi-affiliated forces to advance towards the positions of these forces in eastern Jawf province failed, and in the course of operations against these movements, a number of enemy military equipment was destroyed and dozens were killed or wounded. The remaining forces are also under pursuit in the Jawf desert and gatherings of Saudi-affiliated forces have been targeted using a number of ballistic missiles and drones.
